It describes ReactOS as a potentially compatible drop-in open-source replacement, notable for information about undocumented Windows APIs; development began around 1996, the article calls it alpha and feature-incomplete and advises evaluation/testing use only. It names Adobe Reader 9.3, GIMP 2.6 and LibreOffice 5.4 as working Windows programs, says the code is mostly C with some C++ including the file explorer, and notes collaboration with Wine. The amd64 mention is x86-64, NOT ARM64; the article has no WoW64, xHCI/USB3 or FAT-boot statement.
